decisions.reason: The second attribution to Laozi and part of his reply depend on omitted context.
The two glosses supply different personal names from outside the source fragment.
的 is grammatical before multiple continuations, including 土地; the first gloss also contains an apparent transcription error.
Holding 他们都 fixed, holding office and agreeing are different actions supported by the respective source verbs.
就 is a discourse connective and could introduce a clause about encountering an important matter as well.
The name 黄巢 is supplied for a source that mentions only a rebel envoy.
又 can introduce an account of gaining territory as well as a change of office; the first gloss gives a doubtful interpretation of 略有.
特意 and 特别 can express substantially the same sense in the shared prefix.
The subject name 疏广 is absent from the first source.
The first target supplies a personal name, the second a royal title. Neither is determined by the common date.
After 宣宗 the source distinguishes beginning to dispatch an official from coming to understand.
Recovering the numbered calendar days from cyclical dates requires additional calendrical information.
